ability.kazimod.sky_splitter.description: The user dashes forward and rapidly slashes the opponent with double strikes
ability.kazimod.hiryu_kaen.description.0: The user leaps into the air and releases a big flaming shockwave slash when landing
The user launches a powerful ranged slash, causing great destruction
ability.kazimod.yakkodori.description.0: Launches a crescent moon-shaped slash, which destroys everything in its path
ability.kazimod.skull_basher.description: The user collides their skull with any target within range, applying bleeding.
Spreads bubbles on enemies around, leaving them weakened and immobile
ability.kazimod.radiant_slice.descriptio: The user dashes forward and rapidly slashes the opponent with haki-infused strikes (FRUITLESS)
ability.kazimod.nitoryu_iai_rashomon.des: The user dashes forward slightly, and slashes all those in front of them
ability.kazimod.sulong.description.0: The user reveals their true power during the night, enhancing their physical and electrical power. While active %s stacks are not consumed. Can be used during all non new moon nights or while having a rumble ball eaten. Be careful holding this ability with rumble balls, since past one minute it starts to wear down on you.
ability.kazimod.vicious_roar.description: The user roars with all their might, disorientating any opponent. (Charge time decreases with §aOni Awakening§r)
ability.kazimod.taka_nami.description.0: The user fires an air shockwave in the shape of a bird.
ability.kazimod.sango.description.0: Launches powerful charges of electricity from the hands.
ability.kazimod.flame_blessing.descripti: The user blesses their allies around them for 15 seconds.
ability.kazimod.imperial_flame_ring_comm: Transforms the user into fire and launches them forward, setting on fire all enemies around the user.
ability.kazimod.seiryu_heavy_point.descr: The user transforms into a mythical dragon-hybrid.
ability.kazimod.el_thor.description.0: Focuses a large cluster of electricity above the target, then sends a powerful lightning bolt crashing down from the sky
ability.kazimod.sai_kuru.description.0: By spinning, the user creates two small tornadoes, which slashes and weakens nearby opponents.
The user dashes forward and grabs a nearby target, holding them in place before launching them into the ground with a powerful kick.
ability.kazimod.foxfire_explosion.descri: The user creates a cylindrical area of blue flames that damages and sets enemies on fire
The user compresses air and sends it towards the opponent to create a huge shockwave
ability.kazimod.karakuni.description.0: Removes the oxygen around the user, suffocating and weakening everyone in the vicinity
ability.kazimod.kirin_heavy_point.descri: Transforms the user into a half-mythical Kirin.
ability.kazimod.dreamwave_pulse.descript: The user shoots a small beam at the target that makes them tired for a short duration.
ability.kazimod.slumber_field.descriptio: Creates a drowsy field that fills the area with a sleep-inducing aura, making everyone inside progressively more tired.
ability.kazimod.foxfire_ball.description: The user fires a ball of blue flames at the opponent that erupt into an explosion
ability.kazimod.inga_zarashi.description: Increases your physical prowess depending on how much damage you have in your Karma counter
ability.kazimod.rage_rush.description.0: The user charges forward in a rage, striking all enemies in their path and launching them high into the air. Scales with karma. Requires Inga Zarashi to be active.
ability.kazimod.exploding_karma.descript: Channels karma energy into a massive red sphere above the user that detonates after charging, dealing devastating damage in a massive area. Scales with karma. Requires Inga Zarashi to be active and at least 75 karma to use.
ability.kazimod.partytable_kick_course.d: The user does a hand stand on the ground, legs spread out spinning and dealing damage to all nearby enemies
ability.kazimod.bien_cuit_grill_shot.des: A strong kick that launches the user forwards.
ability.kazimod.berserk.description.0: Enters a short berserk state — every hit restores a bit of health and deals 5% more bonus damage.
ability.kazimod.futenraku.description.0: Infuse your axes with haoskoku and deliver a powerful horizontal slice. (Fruitless)
ability.kazimod.yasotakeru.description.0: The user fires multiple cutting air blades.
ability.kazimod.electrical_missle.descri: Powerful and fast forward dash that will stun enemies.
ability.kazimod.galaxy_impact.descriptio: The user charges a massive shockwave of haki and fires it in any direction, bringing only destruction upon those it strikes.
ability.kazimod.black_hole.description.0: The user spreads darkness over the target area, which engulfs and suffocates anyone and anything inside of it.
ability.kazimod.god_thread.description.0: The user creates sixteen razor-sharp string spears, eight on each side, charging them for a moment before unleashing them all at a single point.
ability.kazimod.gomu_gomu_no_red_roc.des: The user winds up, stretches and grows their arm to punch the opponent with powerful haki and flames.
ability.kazimod.dismantle.description.0: The user slashes an opponent instantly
ability.kazimod.spring_snipe.description: Turning the user's forelegs into springs, they can launch themselves directly at the opponent
ability.kazimod.gomu_gomu_no_kaminari.de: The user launches into the air, winds up, and unleashes a devastating light-blue lightning beam.
By spinning, the user creates a small tornado, which slashes and weakens nearby opponents
ability.kazimod.shi_shishi_sonson.descri: The user dashes forward and rapidly slashes the opponent
ability.kazimod.dragon_whirlwind.descrip: The user charges briefly before dashing forward in any direction, spinning like a whirlwind, slashing and pulling nearby opponents towards them.
ability.kazimod.cleave.description.0: Grabs a nearby enemy and slashes them
ability.kazimod.spiderweb_cleave.descrip: The user sends a web of slashes across a wide area.
ability.kazimod.flow_haki_infusion.descr: Allows the user to infuse their flow haki into whatever weapon they're holding. Cannot be used by those with Conqueror's Haki.
ability.kazimod.fuga.description.0: The users fires off a devastating flame arrow
ability.kazimod.foxfire_style.descriptio: The user ignites their blade with foxfire flames for 7 seconds, enabling fire-imbued sword techniques (FRUITLESS).
ability.kazimod.cluster_bomb.description: The user rapidly fires a series of small explosive projectiles.
ability.kazimod.explosive_hold.descripti: Grabs a nearby enemy and blasts them repeatedly
ability.kazimod.stun_grenade.description: The user detonates a blinding explosive burst, blinding and disorienting
ability.kazimod.propelling_blasts.descri: The user propels themselves forward using a series of small explosions.
ability.kazimod.age_acceleration.descrip: Hit the target to rapidly age them, weakening and slowing them
ability.kazimod.de_aged.description.0: Hit the target to reverse their age, making them smaller and more prone to damage
ability.kazimod.future_of_freedom: Distorted Future: A Future of Freedom
ability.kazimod.future_of_freedom.descri: Turn into the most free version of yourself
Winds up a massive punch with a giant fist. Requires Giant Future to be active
ability.kazimod.giant_future.description: Turns you into an alternate timeline version of yourself where you are a giant
ability.kazimod.heat_dash.description.0: Transforms the user into fire and launches them forward, setting on fire all enemies around the user.
ability.kazimod.hidaruma.description.0: Creates small green fireballs that set the target on fire
ability.kazimod.hiken.description.0: Turns the user's fist into flames and launches it towards the target
ability.kazimod.hellfire_bird.descriptio: Launches a hellfire bird that weakly tracks enemies before erupting in flames.
ability.kazimod.heaven_slash.description: Launches a larger crimson pound slash straight ahead.
ability.kazimod.infernal_column.descript: Calls down a blazing infernal pillar from the sky that scorches everything caught inside.
ability.kazimod.phoenix_dive.description: Launches the user into the air before driving them back down in a blazing area slam.
ability.kazimod.chronostasis.description: Charges up a pulse, then releases a 1-second AOE burst. Any entity caught inside is frozen in time — suspended in a bubble,lifted into the air, and left unable to move or act for 5 seconds. Can be cancelled after the freeze begins, releasing all targets immediately.
ability.kazimod.chronostasis_grigora.des: Freezes all projectiles within a 30-block radius in time, suspending each one inside a temporal bubble. After 5 seconds, the frozen projectiles are erased.
ability.kazimod.time_acceleration.descri: Accelerates the user through time, greatly boosting movement speed, leaving after-images in their wake, and allowing them to phase through incoming attacks.
ability.kazimod.time_reversal.descriptio: Passively records your position and HP every tick. On activation, reverts your position and HP back to what they were 2 seconds ago.
ability.kazimod.time_theft.description.0: Rips time itself from every living thing inside a spherical area, instantly killing them. Entities whose combined Doriki and Busoshoku Haki exceeds the user's power are unaffected.
ability.kazimod.cloudy_day.description.0: Summons a Rain Cloud above the user.
ability.kazimod.gale_storm.description.0: Summons a Windy Cloud that creates a wind barrier around the user, trapping enemies within its range. Requires Cloudy Day to be active
ability.kazimod.lightning_jab.descriptio: The user dashes forward and grabs a nearby target, holding them in place before launching them away with a powerful lightning-charged strike.
ability.kazimod.thunderstorm.description: Calls down lightning bolts onto all enemies within the cloud's range once every 5 seconds. Requires Cloudy Day to be active.
ability.kazimod.tornado_wrath.descriptio: The user wraps themselves in a raging tornado and charges forward, dealing damage to all enemies caught in the vortex.
ability.kazimod.wind_gust.description.0: The user slashes the air, launching a gust of wind at the opponent.
ability.kazimod.red.description.0: Reverses the force of Infinity and fires it as a devastating repelling projectile
ability.kazimod.lapse_blue.description.0: Concentrates the attractive force of Infinity, pulling a target toward you. Once close enough, grab and launch them into the air, then teleport to slam them into the ground. Cannot be used while Max Lapse Blue is on Cooldown
ability.kazimod.max_output_lapse_blue.de: Fires a guided Blue projectile that pulls in entities and absorbs blocks. Use the ability again to toggle the projectile between moving and stopped. Cannot be used while Lapse Blue is on Cooldown
ability.kazimod.hollow_purple.descriptio: Combines Red and Blue into a single imaginary mass, firing it as a massive purple projectile that destroys everything in its path.
ability.kazimod.infinity.description.0: Activates Infinity, an infinite convergence that slows all matter to a halt before it can reach the user. Negates all incoming damage while active
ability.kazimod.domain_expansion_infinit: Entities within are overwhelmed by infinite information, leaving them stunned and helpless.
ability.kazimod.cruel_sun.description.0: At the peak of Sunshine's power, you compress power into a miniature sun, Requires 6 or more Sunshine points.
ability.kazimod.slot_spin.description.0: Displays the current slot number. Use Slot Spin to roll a new number from 0-9
Activates based on your Lucky Slot roll (1-9). Each number triggers a unique casino attack
ability.kazimod.skill_hunter.description: Hit a devil-fruit user while staying in range to steal their ability. Target must have less HP than you. Permanently removes the move from the target. Switch modes to choose which type of ability to steal.
ability.kazimod.skill_hunter.name: Skill Hunter
ability.kazimod.skill_hunter.description: Punch a devil-fruit user with less HP than you to open a 60-second steal window. The first ability they use within 20 blocks is permanently stolen (max 4 abilities).
ability.kazimod.skill_remover.descriptio: Toggle on then use a Stolen Ability slot to return that ability to its original owner instead of using it.
ability.kazimod.skill_book_creation.desc: Manifests the Skill Book. Required to use Skill Hunter and stolen abilities.
ability.kazimod.barrier_guard.descriptio: Creates a barrier sphere around the user or an ally, providing heavy protection
ability.mineminenomi.takt.description.1: §aEMERGENCE§r Summons a spike from the ground.
ability.mineminenomi.takt.description.2: §aTOSS§r Lifts a chunk of earth to throw at enemies.
ability.kazimod.haki_sense.description.0: Sense nearby presences with Haki. Stronger foes feel terrifying, weaker ones feel faint.
ability.kazimod.kanzen_saimin.descriptio: Instantly traps anyone who sees the release in a crushing illusion, blurring reality and leaving them disoriented.
ability.kazimod.illusion_clone_barrage.d: Creates three illusionary doubles around the user, each copying the user's combat style while only carrying a quarter of their vitality.
ability.kazimod.invisible_execution.desc: Leaves a false self behind while the real user vanishes from sight and repositions unnoticed. The illusion breaks the moment the user attacks.
ability.kazimod.illusion_counter.descrip: When struck, the user instantly leaves behind a fake body, avoids the blow, and appears behind the attacker before they can notice the swap.
ability.kazimod.goryutenmetsu.descriptio: Summons a spectral dragon around the user, lifts them skyward, then drives them down onto the aimed target in a devastating violet impact.
After a heavy chant, the user seals the aimed target inside a black coffin that blocks entry, destroys projectiles, and impales them with emerging spikes.
